proc_p: A fitted bedroom usually takes four to six weeks to make after you sign off the design.
steps: We measure the whole room, including slopes, chimney breasts and box sections, and talk through how you use it.
You see wardrobes, bedside units and any dressing table together in 3D, with a quote that lists each piece.
Every piece is made to your room’s measurements in our workshop, so the finishes match across the room.
Our fitters install the whole room and finish it to the walls and ceiling, backed by our 12-month guarantee.
book_p: Tell us about the room and what needs to fit in it. We’ll visit, measure everything and send a 3D design of the finished bedroom with an itemised quote.
